name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is a silver-gold development company advancing its flagship Diablillos project in the Puna region of Salta and Catamarca Provinces, Argentina. The Diablillos project is fully permitted with a Definitive Feasibility Study completed in June 2026, positioning the company as a developer transitioning toward construction of a primary silver mine. The company also holds an earn-in option on the La Coipita project in San Juan Province, Argentina, through a joint venture with Teck.
